description: E1: optuna NSGA-II search at 10 qubits / 8 layers (paper Fig. 2 validation searches 6/8/10/12 q with 4/4/8/8 layers). Objectives (all maximised, averaged over 10 realisations): cumulative NARMA R^2 for n = 1..10 (the paper's text says 1..5, but its Fig. 2a scores exceed 5; see LOG.md; the text definition is recomputed from per-order R^2) noiseless and with N(0, 10^-1.5) noise (std reading), mean minimal MPS bond dimension at F >= 1 - 5e-4 over 10 windows, and mean variability over Unif(-1,1) inputs. Table I is trial 0. Search ranges and budget are ours (unstated in the paper). Local tier.
